observation.command: echo "=== daemon errors in journal? ==="; find /opt/qisutu -path '*var/log*' -type f 2>/dev/null; echo "=== daemon writes ==="; ls -la /opt/qisutu/var/; echo "=== run perl syntax check on daemon ==="; sudo -u qisutu env QISUTU_HOME=/opt/qisutu perl -c /opt/qisutu/bin/qisutu-daemon.pl 2>&1 | tail -5
